title: Which Branches Should Be Removed During Pruning?
content: Small, unnecessary, old, or dead branches should be removed to maintain healthy plant growth.

title: What Are the Benefits of Removing Dead or Unnecessary Branches?
content: Removing dead or unnecessary branches improves plant structure, supports proper growth, and increases overall yield.

title: Which Tools Are Best for Cutting Branches in a Rooftop Garden?
content: Branches should be cut carefully using sharp pruning shears, scissors, or a clean blade to avoid plant damage.

title: What Precautions Should Be Taken While Cutting Branches?
content: Care must be taken to ensure that the main branches and young seedlings are not damaged during pruning.
